name: ML Anomaly Detection on Wazuh Logs & XAI
problemStatement: Security operations struggle to review and audit raw, unstructured intrusion detection logs for behavioral signs of malicious threat vectors.
solution: Built an end-to-end security pipeline that converts raw Wazuh IDS log items into temporal behavioral vectors, evaluating them using ensemble ML classification and SHAP explainer frameworks.
architecture: Wazuh Agent Stream -> Temporal Encoding -> Ensemble Classifier (XGBoost + RF + LSTM) -> SHAP Attribution -> MITRE ATT&CK Alerts
features: Extracted temporal and relational feature vectors from raw IDS log text rows.
Integrated SHAP and LIME explainer components to visualize neural threat attributions.
Mapped security alerts directly to standard MITRE ATT&CK tactic categories in real-time.
challenges: Log streams present high drift and dimensions. Resolved by applying rolling-median imputation and combining deep-sequence models with tree-ensemble models.
results: Decreased alert fatigue by suppressing normal operations with high precision, increasing threat detection speed.

caseStudy.overview: A security log analysis pipeline providing model transparency and actionable explanation layers alongside anomaly scores.
workflow: Inflow streaming log rows are ingested via standard agent channels.
Inputs are scaled and imputed using rolling historical medians.
The reconstruction anomaly scores are evaluated against ensemble trees.
Local perturbation paths (SHAP/LIME) compute feature attribution ranks.
Explanations are mapped directly to visible MITRE ATT&CK categories.
caseStudy.dataset: Wazuh IDS logs and simulated network threat vectors (1.2M records).
caseStudy.model: Ensemble Anomaly Classifier (XGBoost + Random Forest + LSTM/GRU)
caseStudy.evaluation: SHAP feature importance ranking mapped to threat categories.
caseStudy.deployment: Containerized FastAPI server pushing alerts to security outputs.
caseStudy.futureImprovements: Real-time incremental parameter updates for ongoing logs drift.

name: Hindi Speech Recognition with Whisper
problemStatement: Hindi speech recognition project using Whisper, with fine-tuning and WER/CER evaluation on a speaker-disjoint test split.
solution: Provides a Streamlit app for audio upload or microphone input, Hindi transcription, English translation, and batch processing.
architecture: Audio Wave Input -> Spectrogram Transformation -> Recurrent Seq2Seq Net -> CTC Decoder -> REST CLI Output
features: Normalizes voice clips using sound-wave filtering techniques.
Converts raw audio waves into Mel-Spectrogram matrix parameters.
Exposes simple REST API endpoints to load voice files and retrieve string outputs.
challenges: Various voice accents and dialect speeds degrade word error rates. Solved by training models on augmented Mozilla Common Voice files.
results: Achieved stable transcription speed and low Word Error Rate even in medium environmental noise.

caseStudy.overview: Deep sequence-to-sequence speech transcription pipeline tailored to low-resource audio datasets.
workflow: Hindi raw audio files are normalized and filtered for noise.
Audio sequences are converted into MFCC mel-spectrogram arrays.
Trained neural architecture consumes temporal audio vectors.
Decoder maps features into tokens and outputs Hindi strings.
caseStudy.dataset: Mozilla Common Voice Hindi Dataset (augmented audio clips).
caseStudy.evaluation: WER valuation on unseen voice clips.
caseStudy.futureImprovements: Upgrading acoustic layer using Conformer backbones.

name: ResumeIQ — AI Resume & Career Assistant
problemStatement: Job seekers need practical resume feedback, ATS guidance, interview practice, career direction, and tailored application materials in one place.
solution: Built a resume-analysis application that extracts text from uploaded PDFs and uses five specialized Gemini prompts to generate actionable career reports.
architecture: PDF Upload -> pdfplumber Text Extraction -> 8,000-Character Input Limit -> Five Gemini Analyses -> Interactive Reports
features: Reviews resume strengths, weaknesses, improvements, and recruiter recommendations.
Provides ATS feedback, tailored interview questions, and a six-month career roadmap.
Generates a personalized cover letter and presents results in separate report tabs.
challenges: Resume documents vary in length and formatting. Extracted text is capped at 8,000 characters for predictable model input, and text-based PDFs are recommended.
results: Delivers five resume and career analysis tools through a responsive website while preserving the original Streamlit application.

caseStudy.overview: An AI career companion that turns a text-based PDF resume into recruiter-style feedback and a practical job-search plan.
workflow: Upload a text-based PDF resume through the website.
Extract readable resume text with pdfplumber.
Send five specialized prompts to Google Gemini.
Review the results in separate report tabs.
caseStudy.dataset: Text extracted from the candidate's uploaded PDF resume.
caseStudy.model: Five Gemini-powered modules: resume review, ATS checker, interview prep, career roadmap, and cover letter.
caseStudy.evaluation: Five focused reports covering resume quality, ATS fit, interview preparation, career direction, and cover-letter drafting.
caseStudy.accuracy: Not a predictive classification model; output quality depends on resume content and AI responses.
caseStudy.deployment: Responsive Flask website deployed on Vercel; original Streamlit app retained.
caseStudy.futureImprovements: Add OCR support for scanned or image-only PDF resumes.
